snippets.DEFEAT_TEXT: Unfortunately you didn't finish the level. Next time you'll be better for sure!
snippets.INSTRUCTION2_TEXT: Play with your mouse in order to click on the tables. To serve your dinner guests you must do the following:
snippets.INSTRUCTION3_TEXT: - Greet a guest - Show them to a table - Give them a menu - Ask them what they wish to order - Bring them their order - Accept their money
snippets.INSTRUCTION_TEXT: Help your panda earn some money by working as a waiter in the restaurant. With the money earned your panda will be able to fullfill his/her dream and travel throughout the world. You have to treat the guests courteously and be efficient, be quick and polite because the guests can get angry if there is bad service. They may even leave if you are too slow. And If you make mistakes you will have to throw the food away. If you can save some money you will be able to buy faster shoes, relaxing music or a pet bolly that will be able to assist you on serving the guess.
snippets.MENU_TEXT: Help your panda save money for a holiday.
snippets.VICTORY_TEXT: Thanks to your help your panda can now take a holiday!
snippets.WYCIECZKA1: Thanks to your help your panda can go to Egypt on holiday!
snippets.WYCIECZKA2: Thanks to your help your panda can go to Africa on holiday!
snippets.WYCIECZKA3: Thanks to your help your panda can go to the Moon on holiday!
